Grain lines and piece names stay inside their pieces [skip ci]

ar: خط اتجاه النسيج واسم القطعة لا يخرجان خارج حدود قطعتهما — في ملف القص (PLT / ISO / DXF) وعلى الشاشة

The owner, with a picture of a marker whose grain lines and names ran out of the pockets and the placket onto the
pieces beside them: «اجعل دائماً الخطوط لا تخرج خارج حدود قطعتها».
- geometry.grain_inside: the grain line cut to the inside of its piece (5 mm from the cut line), in its direction;
  drawn beside the piece: the same direction through its middle, as long as it was or as the piece allows.
- geometry.fit_text: the piece's name centred in its piece (its middle, or the point deepest inside) and smaller
  until it fits (12 mm at most, 4 mm at least) — it started at the middle and ran to the right.
- Used in marker_scene (every export) and in the marker view.
